goal: Create a sandbox‑confined, reproducible pipeline that automatically ingests PDFs of monocular depth estimation papers (2023‑2025), extracts structured attributes (architecture, training regime, performance metrics, datasets, hardware) via LLM prompting, stores them in a SQLite taxonomy, and generates a hierarchical taxonomy visualisation. The experiment validates that the end‑to‑end workflow runs reliably and achieves ≥ 90 % extraction precision on a sampled review set.

config.llm_provider: openai_gpt4o (or compatible Open‑Source model via LangChain)
